label: MODEL-ONLY PREDICTION. Not a flight result, not a firmware result, not part of the speed ranking.
blind_status: Written before any TROPIC ARM lead-off search was flown or published. Checked on 2026-11-13: no lead-off search files in any commit, branch or release of this repository. The commit that adds this file is the timestamp of record.
applies_to: Lead-off (controller.feedforward = off) cells of docs/results/arm-speed/speed-rule.json, both stacks, on the same course, plant, gates and K = 6/s.

shortest_lead_off_lap_s.statement: Each stack's lead-off search selects 26 s (or 27 s), well below the 33 s lead-on result.

prediction.stack_difference: The model has no firmware. Both stacks followed tilt commands with about the same 170 ms delay at 33 s, so the model predicts the same lead-off lap for both: a tie, or at most 1 s apart.

worst_error_m.lap_33: about 0.48 (already observed for CogniPilot at 33 s realistic noise: 0.475-0.480; used to set the offset)

prediction.why: Drag in the plant makes the drone lag behind the reference; the 1/K attitude lag pushes it ahead and outward. With lead off these partly cancel, so lead-off tracks better than lead-on (which removes the attitude lag and leaves the drag error). This is a model explanation, not a measured firmware property.

falsified_if: Either stack's confirmed lead-off lap is 24 s or shorter, or 29 s or longer.
The two stacks' lead-off laps differ by 2 s or more.
Lead-off is not shorter than lead-on (33 s) for either stack.
Worst error at the selected lead-off lap differs from the predicted value by more than 0.05 m.

model.description: Pure Modelica: shared Benchmarks.Trajectory and Benchmarks.PositionLoop (unchanged), full RDD2 plant via Benchmarks.IdealAttitudePlant (drag on), attitude roll/pitch modelled as a first-order lag at 6/s standing in for firmware, lead off. One noise-free run per lap.
model.offset_method: Model minus CogniPilot ARM lead-off flights at 33 s = 0.040-0.045 m (0.5196 vs 0.4751-0.4796). Subtracting 0.040-0.045 m from raw model worst error gives the predicted values. Raw model alone selects 27 s (26 s fails at 0.761 m).
model.tools: Rumoca 0.10.0, solver rk-like, output step 0.01 s, on modelica_models a41f7c0 plus patches/modelica-report-fixes.patch and patches/modelica-shared-position.patch, in scratch copies only.
model.evidence_folder: Outside the repository: ~/Desktop/pure-model-lead-20261113/ (RESULTS.md, harness .mo files, CSV outputs) on the author's machine.

not_modelled: Firmware estimator, filters, rate loop and either stack's specific attitude response beyond a 6/s first-order lag
Sensor noise (flights at 33 s varied by about 0.01 m in worst error across noise levels)
250 Hz stick schedule; lap starts from hover at 10 s rather than 25 s
Betaflight motor protocol scheduling effects (affects landing, which this prediction does not cover)
Landing, disarm and the full-mission result
use: Compare against the lead-off cells after the searches finish and report agreement or disagreement either way. This file must not influence the search, the rule or the data freeze.
